<!-- pr-reviewer: 90786d5b469dad6754dfa112f470db5c306f7290 -->
**Needs changes before merge.** One refusal sentence is untrue at its site; the rest holds.

**What looks good**
- The "furniture" literals in `commands/setup.rs`, `commands/tool.rs` and the two model commands are gone; no user-visible "furniture" string is left in `crates/app` or `crates/ui` (remaining hits are comments, identifiers and test assertions).
- Refusal conditions are unchanged; the diff is string literals, two test edits and the decisions file. The head already contains origin/main (4c3f7565), so no trial merge was needed.
- The `setup.rs:109` and `tool.rs:32` messages match their triggers (`Stock`, `G54`..`G59`, and the `X/Stock` / `X/WCS` shapes).
- Guard test `setup_refusals_never_say_furniture` builds real refusals through the commands.
- No textual conflict with #880 (`tool.rs`) when merged with it; no overlap with #883.

**Local results (head 90786d5b, on origin/main 4c3f7565)**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test repair_model` | 4 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test setups` | 12 passed, 0 failed (includes `setup_refusals_never_say_furniture`) |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**
1. `crates/app/src/commands/repair_model.rs:47` and `crates/app/src/commands/update_model.rs:81`: "is part of a setup (its stock, work offset or fixtures)" is false for everything else that reaches this branch. `model::is_model` (`crates/app/src/model.rs:150-157`) also excludes tools, operations, setup entities and program entries, and `find_by_name` finds them. So naming a tool or an operation gets a sentence that calls it a setup part. Fixtures cannot reach the branch at all (`is_model` does not exclude them). Suggested wording for both sites: `'{name}' is not a model - it is a setup's stock or work offset, a setup, a tool, an operation or other CAM data`. Update `repair_model.rs` test line 81-83 to match (it asserts on "part of a setup"), and the decision file.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
- `commands/setup.rs:95`: the message says names with '/' are "reserved for a setup's own stock and work offset", but the check refuses every name containing '/'. That reads fine; say if you want "must not contain" kept closer to the old wording.
- Changelog `none` is acceptable: wording only, no behaviour change. If you want it in the release notes, the row would be: `Refusals name a setup's stock, work offset and fixtures in plain words instead of 'furniture'`.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 59c4b955542ea0f285c99fcc0c9da7b293c21fd0 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** Read-only re-check of the delta from the reviewed head 90786d5b to 59c4b955. Not rebuilt on this review; the author's gate on this head is named in the PR body (repair_model 5 passed, setups 12 passed, commands_undo update_validates_at_construction 1 passed, clippy -p camcraft-app clean).

**Blocker status**
1. `crates/app/src/commands/repair_model.rs:47` and `crates/app/src/commands/update_model.rs:81`: fixed. Both now read `"'{name}' is not a model - it is a setup's stock or work offset, a setup, a tool, an operation or other CAM data"`. The branch condition is unchanged, and the sentence covers what `is_model` excludes (setups, tools, operations, program entries).
2. Test wording (`crates/app/tests/repair_model.rs`): fixed. The existing assertion now expects "is not a model", and the new `tools_and_operations_are_refused_as_not_models_not_setup_parts` checks a tool and an operation through both `RepairModel` and `UpdateModel`.

**Delta check**
- Only string literals changed in `repair_model.rs`, `update_model.rs` and `fixture.rs`, plus test code and the decision file. No logic change.
- No snapshot PNG in the delta.
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` in non-test code; the new `expect` calls are in the test only.
- Changed user-facing strings contain no "furniture", "G-word" or "work offset word".

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `fixture.rs` (TagFixture refusal) is reworded to the same sentence with no test pinning it; the author says so in the PR body.
- `Changelog: none` is acceptable for wording-only changes.
- Process: the PR was flagged ready at the quick pass (on 90786d5b) and then took the push to 59c4b955 without going back to draft first, as AGENTS.md "Draft PRs" asks. Noted for the maintainer; it does not change the code verdict.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
